details: The brush 'brush' event fires render() on every mousemove with no debouncing or RAF coalescing; render() calls updateTable() which fully tears down and rebuilds all 6 sparkline SVGs (sparkTd.selectAll('*').remove() + re-joining rects) on every frame, causing heavy DOM thrashing at 60fps. No transitions are used so there are no handoff race issues, yScales is read dynamically so no stale closure, and there are no cross-view dispatchers that could loop.
